author: Jamal_067
quote: The game is unimaginably boring, it drops to a disgustingly low 15fps, and the characters are not only unlikable, but repulsive. I do NOT  recommend anyone to buy this game, I wouldn't even want this if they PAID me 100 dollars, and if you waited 13 years for this I generally feel sorry for you and you deserve literal compensation for extreme emotional damage. Please, if you have not played this and is a fan of the gta series, do not buy it or you will not just be extremely disappointed, but disgusted,Repulsed, and outraged at the same time. The positive review around it is mostly gta fans that is mentally broken by the reality, and trying to cope with waiting 13 years for a disgustingly repulsive game launch. I would rather spend 100 dollars on loot boxes in a dying mobile game than buying gta 6, because at least opening them gives me some microscopic level of fun compared to the absolute joke ****, this so called "gta 6", give me.
